mainText: Hello, Verona! At 9 PM, we are looking at 70 degrees with clear skies over Badger Prairie County Park. We are currently under a waxing crescent moon, and the space station will be visible tomorrow morning at 5:35 AM as it travels from the direction of Mount Horeb toward Fitchburg and Madison, appearing almost directly overhead. The overnight low will be 62 degrees with no rain in the forecast.

The city has shared two important updates. First, the common council has approved new sewer and stormwater rates to ensure the sustainability of our utilities and avoid future service failures. Second, the I Voted sticker contest winners have been announced, featuring student artwork that will be available at polling locations for the November 3 general election.

We have a busy week ahead. Today you can attend the UGM at Epic Systems or join a yoga class at Insight Wellness. Tomorrow, we have trivia options at Hop Haus and Wisconsin Brewing Company. Wednesday offers more trivia at The Bogey Factory, pizza at Lake Lou-ee, and the downtown farmer's market, followed by the final Concerts in the Park on Thursday.

In our weekly police report, on August 15, an officer conducted a traffic stop that resulted in a 29-year-old man being arrested for a second offence O W I, along with citations for driving after revocation and having open intoxicants.

Today's delicious flavor of the day is Caramel Peanut Buttercup. The store is closing in less than one hour, so make sure to get there soon. If you miss out, tomorrow's flavor will be Caramel Chocolate Pecan.
